name: Esentia Energy Development, S.A.B. de C.V.
summary: Esentia Energy Development, S.A.B. de C.V. engages in the transportation and commercialization of natural gas in Mexico. The company offers natural gas marketing, pipeline, transportation, and compression station operation and maintenance services. It operates interconnected natural gas systems that deliver natural gas from Waha, Texas, across central Mexico to the principal industrial regions. The company was founded in 1960 and is based in Mexico City, Mexico.
